title: Cohomology of a coherent module on a proper algebraic space over a Noetherian affine base is a finite module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma, stated for a Noetherian base and a proper morphism of algebraic spaces, concludes that the cohomology of a coherent module is a finite module over the base ring in every degree (statement lines 4011-4017). The proof is an assembly of three identifications: quasi-coherence of the higher direct images lets them be read off from their global sections, the Leray identification together with vanishing on the affine base computes those global sections as $H^i(X, \mathcal{F})$, and the affine criterion for coherence turns coherence into finite generation. The translation between coherence on the base and finiteness of the cohomology modules is the substance, so the claim is H2.
